interface: Local splitting for coprime smooth characteristic factors yields integrable complementary distributions and blocks depending on their own coordinates, even at algebraically nongeneric points. A smooth Nijenhuis block with no real spectrum has a canonical integrable complex structure and holomorphic operator coefficients. Theorem6.1 states persistence of a nonreal eigenvalue with constant algebraic multiplicity on a closed connected manifold. Theorem4.5 assumes independent coefficients of factored characteristic polynomials and realizes arbitrary types at points, generically becoming semisimple nearby.
role: Load-bearing local splitting/holomorphic interfaces for the paper’s weaker zero-point obstruction, and credited earlier point realizations.
limits: Source is author-v2, not equated to unread Advances in Mathematics publisher bytes. Point realization is distinct from a fixed nonsemisimple type on an open domain and a global compact transition.

interface: Symmetries of a gl-regular Nijenhuis generator are Nijenhuis, including outputs that may be zero or singular. Variable polynomial coefficients must satisfy the displayed differential compatibility equations. For a single nilpotent Jordan block, the smooth local symmetry formula depends on triangular Toeplitz coordinates; for size3 its upper-right coefficient includes an unwrapped coordinate times a derivative of a transverse function.
role: Accurate boundary on a possible prior local construction route.
limits: No claim that outputs must remain gl-regular; no blanket exclusion of other uses of this framework. The formula by itself does not establish periodic angular dependence or exact compact zero bands.
